obligations.note: The change raises payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and controls/payments/policy-params.json payments.privileged_idle_minutes from 15 to 16. That breaks the catalog bound payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15, and no valid exception covers it (see EXC-1).

The change relies on EXC-0193, an SES-1 exception for payments.session. It expired on 2026-10-27, before the review time of 2026-10-28T18:09Z. An expired exception doesn't count, so the deviation is uncovered.
Ticket CHG-26457 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-23 before review. Its components (payments.controls-data, payments.policy) cover both changed files.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author Jonah Weiss, gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 68df7e48, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims head commit 68df7e48, but the JUnit report is timestamped 2026-10-23 from hostname dev-laptop-7.local. That predates the 2026-10-25 commit, so it cannot be a test of the final commit. It also shows the SES-1 control test passing against a value of 16 that breaks the bound.
The protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json changed. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office team, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers the changed symbol (policy.py PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES) or the changed param, so no earlier evidence lapses.

summary: The change sets the Payments privileged idle timeout to 16 minutes, which breaks SES-1's 15-minute bound. The only exception cited, EXC-0193, expired the day before review, so it gives no cover. The CI test report predates the head commit and comes from a personal machine, so it is not valid evidence that the final commit was tested. The change is rejected.
